findings.issue: Sense inversion: 'rarely fails to go out' means she goes out almost always — the opposite of めったに外出しない ('she rarely goes out'). 'Fails to' has no counterpart in the Japanese; the lit_pt ('raramente não sai') mirrors correctly but the lit_en does not.
findings.current: As for her, she rarely fails to go out.
findings.suggested: As for her, (she) rarely goes out (lit. rarely + does-not-go-out).

findings.issue: Annotation on the wrong て. In 待ってて the FIRST て (tokens[5]) is just the て of the te-form 待って; the contracted progressive auxiliary (remnant of いて) is the SECOND て (tokens[6], currently all null). The gloss/role/note for the auxiliary must move to tokens[6].
findings.suggested: null (て da forma て de 待つ); mover glosa/nota do auxiliar contraído para o segundo て (tokens[6])
